messages:
Alex Morgan: Hypothetical emergency meeting: were carving an Office Mug Mount Rushmore. Which mug gets the presidential slot? (yes this is important) :coffee:
Jamie Ortiz: the chipped blue one from the pantry. has held more coffee and secrets than any other mug. :heart:
Samir Das: Hackathon mug with the stack-trace joke. earned in blood. :skull:
Zoe Park: The giant insulated thermos that never loses heat. functional supremacy. :thermometer:
Tina (intern): My tiny cactus mug for morale. also it cheers me up. :cactus:
poll-bot: Poll created: "Office Mug Mount Rushmore" Options: Chipped blue / Hackathon mug / Insulated thermos / Cactus mug / Mystery holiday mug — vote with emoji reactions.
Alex Morgan: also honorable mention to any mug with lipstick ring. that's a culture artifact. :lips:
Jamie Ortiz: Vote placed (Chipped blue).
Samir Das: Vote placed (Hackathon mug).
Zoe Park: Vote placed (Insulated thermos).
Tina (intern): Vote placed (Cactus mug).
Alex Morgan: Current tally update: thermos x3, chipped blue x2, hackathon x2, cactus x1, mystery x0 — thermos creeping ahead.
Samir Das: Tie-breaker proposal: if thermos wins, we declare a "bring-a-mug-that-matters" day and document mug stories.
Jamie Ortiz: yes please. mug storytime at lunch. stickers for the top 3. :sticker:
poll-bot: Poll closed automatically — winner: Insulated thermos.
Alex Morgan: Museum day scheduled. bring mugs, bring drama, bring cleaning supplies. (also label yours or risk the great mug swap of 2026) :broom:
Tina (intern): noted. labeling kit on the way. :label:
Zoe Park: Can we also make a tiny plaque for the thermos? it deserves recognition. :medal_sports:
